name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 5 visits over 29 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 29 hours starting 2025-08-12, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 3.79 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
